proposed_first_batch.reason: same cache-free one-lock-register layout, 64-KiB main memory on exact selected parts, own manuals corroborate byte programming and512-byte page erase
proposed_first_batch.scope: blocking main-storage region driver only; no security, OTP, SLIB, chip erase, DMA, interrupt-driven async, timeout abort or full-image self-programming
prerequisites: audited exclusive linker-reserved storage region or unsafe construction contract
byte-level erased preflight and no MultiwriteNorFlash
unconditional exact MODE replacement and BUSY completion before restoring read/lock state
preserve RCC-managed WAIT and do not reset controller in constructor
own per-family voltage constraints and explicit latency/stall disclosure

api_constraints.public_shape: flash module; Flash with Peri<FLASH> lifetime ownership; explicit Blocking marker and Embassy-style blocking_read/write/erase and embedded-storage error mapping; region layout only where hardware and ownership permit
api_constraints.safe_storage_boundary: A FLASH peripheral token does not uniquely own main-array bytes referenced by code/statics. Until linker reservations are owned by a unique token, creating a mutable reserved storage region must be unsafe with a no-code/no-live-data/no-overlap contract. General whole-image writes remain unsafe/unavailable.
api_constraints.main_flash_zero_address: Do not copy upstream core::slice::from_raw_parts(base+offset,len): base0/offset0 is a null Rust reference. Audit a raw hardware memory access path valid at zero, without constructing references.
api_constraints.bounds: Use checked arithmetic for offset+length, halfword/word counts, base+offset and erase endpoints. Zero-length requests must not create invalid references. Erase end is exclusive and both ends512-aligned. Capacity is exact part or explicitly proven region, never the generic die maximum.
api_constraints.write: READ_SIZE=1, WRITE_SIZE=1, ERASE_SIZE=512; natural halfword/word alignment only for optimized physical accesses. Preflight all addressed programmed bytes equal0xFF; repeated1-to0 writes still fail. Skip FF-only work when safe; report partial progress on failures, no atomic transaction promise.
api_constraints.locking: Unlock only the protection group(s) that overlap target pages, preserve other lock bits, restore controlled lock state after BUSY=0. Group size is2048 bytes for F002/F003 and4096 bytes otherwise.
api_constraints.state: wait idle; clear implemented errors by W0C without RMW of WO bits; configure operation by replacing MODE; trigger a naturally aligned store; wait idle; capture error mask; return MODE=Read; restore cache state and locks. Never OR MODE or restore stale nonzero MODE.
api_constraints.async: No completion IRQ exists in audited maps; FLASHRAM is shared with RAM errors. Do not copy STM32 Async/EOP handler. Polling in flash stalls executor and cannot enforce software deadlines while instruction fetch is stalled. Any future RAM-resident asynchronous flow needs full transitive code/literal/vector/DMA analysis and safe cancellation.
api_constraints.large_page_counts: Upstream FlashSector.index_in_bank and FlashRegion::sectors() areu8; L083 needs at leastu16/usize for256/512 pages. Four lock registers do not prove four independently operable memory banks.
api_constraints.timeouts: Datasheet durations are typical only. A timeout is diagnostic, not a documented cancellation. Never resume changing controller state or unlock/relock while still busy. No safe reset/retry after interruption established.
api_constraints.power_and_reset: Keep supply within own chip range for full operation. Do not enter deep sleep while busy; no power-fail atomicity. Active-low peripheral reset exists but resets wait-state configuration and is not an approved BUSY abort; do not reset during construction at high clocks.
unavailable: read-protection level setters or SDK magic reset addresses
OTP, factory trim, boot ROM and option/protected areas
pretend EOP IRQ, dual bank or DMA programming support
api_constraints.SLIB_exclusion: L010/L011/L012 hardware capacity remains64KiB, but default safe storage excludes0xFFF0..0xFFFF and its whole512-byte erase page, plus active protected library pages. Do not place a default last-page settings store there.

hardware_validation_required: With explicit board/destructive-region authorization only: byte/halfword/word write at representative VDD/HCLK and cache settings, all page and lock-group boundaries, last supported address, erased preconditions and PC/locked/protected error flags
Check instruction-fetch stall/IRQ latency, watchdog budget, reset and supply-loss recovery separately; source/compile tests do not establish these
For L083 validate page255/256/511 arithmetic and lock-register transitions without treating register banks as memory banks
Use a declared non-code storage partition and verify adjacent pages/groups are unchanged; never automatically erase a board image

Incrementing an unaligned original address by512 can omit the final crossed page/group (erase start0x1FF,end0x200 is a concrete crossed-page case). Compute page/group indices instead.

Special control writes and reset lie outside ordinary storage operations. SECURITY in FLASH is RO; manual directs protection configuration to ISP. Magic SDK addresses are insufficient basis for a safe HAL setter.
